note: Canonical registry of the Projects surface. Single source of truth for ids, classification, launch URLs and integration declarations. Mission wording (question, evidence prompts, product, choices) is NOT copied here: it stays in curriculum/projects/studio/projects.mjs and is referenced by id. title/unit/family are mirrors pinned by validate:projects-registry. unit is the CURRENT Reveal-TOC number; legacyFolder is the /math/unit-N/ folder. Counts shown on public pages derive from this file via tools/lib/project-registry.mjs. launchUrl never changes what a URL answers.

classifications.flagship: Lead project of a current unit.
classifications.version: Alternate version for the same current unit.
classifications.stretch: Extension expedition a teacher assigns; the unit hub labels it stretch/extension.
classifications.companion: Standalone project page outside the unit folders.
